title: A cap whose field path always resolves to nothing
why: Nastier than 02 because the constraint TYPE is valid. The path uses a wildcard and an aggregate the resolver has neither, so the field reads as absent and the cap is skipped-as-passed on every call, forever.
manifest:
capability:
  id: "@acme/comms.send"
  version: 1.0.0
  name: Send
  description: Send a message with attachments.
  risk_level: medium
  provider: {org: acme, type: internal, verified: true}
  implements: comms.send
  inputs:
    - name: body
      type: string
      required: true
  constraints:
    - type: threshold
      name: total_attachment_size
      description: Maximum 25MB total attachment size
      field: attachments.*.size_bytes.sum()
      max: 25000000
  execution:
    handler: {type: noop, message: "ok"}
